bowling_scenarios.name: Defend 12 Runs in Final 2 Balls
bowling_scenarios.description: Bowler defending 12 or fewer runs with at most 2 legal balls remaining in the 2nd innings.
bowling_scenarios.tactical_intent: Identifies elite boundary-prevention execution where a single six or four swings the match outcome.
bowling_scenarios.relaxation_explanation: Expanded observation window to final 3 balls and runs to defend up to 15.

bowling_scenarios.name: Defend 18 Runs in Final 6 Balls
bowling_scenarios.description: Bowler bowling the final over (Over 20) defending 18 or fewer runs in a 2nd-innings chase.
bowling_scenarios.tactical_intent: The canonical 20th-over franchise test: can the bowler defend 3 boundaries when the opposition is in full assault?
bowling_scenarios.relaxation_explanation: Relaxed window to 8 balls remaining and up to 22 runs to defend.

bowling_scenarios.name: Defend 10 Runs in Final 3 Balls
bowling_scenarios.description: High-leverage micro-window: defending 10 or fewer runs with 3 or fewer legal balls remaining.
bowling_scenarios.tactical_intent: Measures clutch dot-ball generation and yorker execution with no margin for error.
bowling_scenarios.relaxation_explanation: Relaxed window to 4 balls remaining and up to 13 runs to defend.

bowling_scenarios.name: Respond to Boundary Conceded (t+1 Legal Ball)
bowling_scenarios.description: Next legal delivery bowled within the same over immediately after conceding a 4 or 6.
bowling_scenarios.tactical_intent: Isolates mental discipline and damage-containment: does the bowler compound errors or restore pressure?
bowling_scenarios.relaxation_explanation: Extended previous boundary trigger to either of the prior 2 balls bowled.

bowling_scenarios.name: Respond After 8+ Runs in 3 Legal Balls
bowling_scenarios.description: Deliveries bowled immediately following a mini-collapse where the bowler conceded >= 8 runs in rolling 3 balls.
bowling_scenarios.tactical_intent: Measures resilience under acute momentum shifts in high-scoring match phases.
bowling_scenarios.relaxation_explanation: Lowered cluster concession threshold from 8 to 7 runs in 3 balls.

bowling_scenarios.name: Defend Small Target vs Lower Order (2–3 Wickets Left)
bowling_scenarios.description: Defending a tight margin (<= 40 runs to win) when the batting team has only 2–3 wickets in hand.
bowling_scenarios.tactical_intent: Evaluates closing efficiency against the opposition tail without leaking loose boundaries.
bowling_scenarios.relaxation_explanation: Expanded batting wickets in hand to 4 and runs to defend up to 50.

bowling_scenarios.name: Defend vs High RRR with 6+ Wickets Remaining
bowling_scenarios.description: 2nd innings defense where Required Run Rate is >= 11.0 RPO, but the chasing side still has 6+ wickets in hand.
bowling_scenarios.tactical_intent: Measures defensive suppression against deep batting lineups ready to hit indiscriminately.
bowling_scenarios.relaxation_explanation: Lowered RRR threshold to 10.0 and wickets in hand threshold to 5.

bowling_scenarios.name: Death-Over Extreme Pressure Containment
bowling_scenarios.description: All deliveries bowled in the Death Phase (Overs 16–20) classified as EXTREME pressure by the RR EDGE engine.
bowling_scenarios.tactical_intent: Comprehensive benchmark for franchise death bowlers facing acute resource or scoreboard pressure.
bowling_scenarios.relaxation_explanation: Included HIGH pressure tier deliveries alongside EXTREME tier in the death phase.

batting_scenarios.name: Chase 12 Runs in Final 6 Balls
batting_scenarios.description: Chasing team needs 12 or more runs in the final over (Over 20, <= 6 legal balls remaining) with <= 15 runs required.
batting_scenarios.tactical_intent: The supreme finisher test: boundary generation on demand in the deciding over.
batting_scenarios.relaxation_explanation: Expanded balls remaining to 8 and required run rate minimum to 10.0 RPO.

batting_scenarios.name: Chase 18 Runs in Final 12 Balls
batting_scenarios.description: Chasing team needs 18–25 runs across the penultimate and final overs (Overs 19–20) with RRR >= 9.0.
batting_scenarios.tactical_intent: Evaluates two-over tactical pacing: balancing strike rotation with calculated boundary attempts.
batting_scenarios.relaxation_explanation: Broadened window to 5–14 balls remaining and up to 30 runs to chase.

batting_scenarios.name: Chase 30 Runs in Final 18 Balls
batting_scenarios.description: Chasing team needs >= 30 runs from the final 3 overs (Overs 18–20) with RRR >= 10.0 RPO.
batting_scenarios.tactical_intent: Identifies explosive middle-to-death hitters who can take down premier bowlers in the late overs.
batting_scenarios.relaxation_explanation: Extended window to 11–20 balls remaining with RRR >= 9.0 RPO.

batting_scenarios.name: Recover After Losing a Wicket
batting_scenarios.description: Deliveries faced in the immediate 6 balls following a batting dismissal.
batting_scenarios.tactical_intent: Tests stability and composure: avoiding cluster collapses while keeping the scoreboard moving.
batting_scenarios.relaxation_explanation: Expanded post-wicket evaluation window from 6 to 10 deliveries.

batting_scenarios.name: Recover After 2+ Consecutive Dot Balls
batting_scenarios.description: Deliveries faced by a batter who has accumulated a personal streak of >= 2 dot balls.
batting_scenarios.tactical_intent: Measures attacking resilience: breaking drought pressure with scoring shots or boundaries.
batting_scenarios.relaxation_explanation: Relaxed trigger to personal dot streak of >= 1 dot with strike rate pressure.

batting_scenarios.name: Perform When RRR Surges Sharply (Delta RRR >= 3.0)
batting_scenarios.description: 2nd innings chase deliveries where the required rate has escalated by >= 3.0 runs/over from the opening target.
batting_scenarios.tactical_intent: Evaluates aggressive adaptability when previous quiet overs have put the team behind the game.
batting_scenarios.relaxation_explanation: Lowered RRR surge delta from 3.0 to 2.0 runs per over.

batting_scenarios.name: Death Acceleration with 6+ Wickets in Hand
batting_scenarios.description: Death overs (16–20) batting with a deep batting order remaining (>= 6 wickets in hand).
batting_scenarios.tactical_intent: Measures maximum boundary exploitation when resources permit high-risk attacking cricket.
batting_scenarios.relaxation_explanation: Reduced wickets in hand threshold from 6 to 4.

batting_scenarios.name: Preserve Wickets While RRR >= 10.0 RPO
batting_scenarios.description: High-wire act: Chasing with RRR >= 10.0 RPO while batting with the lower order (<= 4 wickets in hand).
batting_scenarios.tactical_intent: Evaluates elite tactical maturity: hitting boundaries without throwing away the final wickets.
batting_scenarios.relaxation_explanation: Relaxed RRR minimum to 9.0 and maximum wickets in hand to 5.
